project_option: Option 1 - ImmXrsive Talent and Industry Platform

checks.method_or_action: POST legacy_export.json as staff (or run scripts/migrate-legacy.mjs) twice
checks.setup: Uses fixtures/final/legacy_export.json and compares report against fixtures/final/legacy_expected_results.json.
checks.expected_behavior: First run imports 6 students, 3 projects, 3 companies, 4 collaborations and reports LS04->LS01 duplicate, LP02->LS99 broken reference, and LS02/LS05/LS06 unclaimed profiles. Second run reports 0 created and creates no duplicates.

checks.method_or_action: List unclaimed profiles (/api/final/claimable), submit claim (/api/final/claims), and review as staff (/r4-staff.html -> /api/final/staff/claims)
checks.setup: Unclaimed legacy profiles exist after migration. Reviewer test access details supplied in Moodle Online text.
checks.expected_behavior: Auto-approval occurs only on exact verified email match. Ambiguous or different-email claims enter staff review. Legacy emails are never exposed publicly.

checks.method_or_action: Set current/alumni status, Active Talent vs Showcase Only, reconfirm availability (/api/final/profile/reconfirm-availability), or retire profile (/api/final/profile/retire)
checks.setup: LS02 has availability_confirmed older than 365 days (2024-06-01); LS06 is retired and linked to LP03.
checks.expected_behavior: Alumni status does not expire Algoma verification; availability older than 365 days is not presented as active job-seeking until reconfirmed; retired profiles are hidden from directory while shared projects and historical collaborations remain intact.

checks.method_or_action: Merge duplicate student (/api/final/staff/merge/students) or company (/api/final/staff/merge/partners), then visit the merged public URL
checks.setup: Merge LS04 into LS01 or LC02 into LC01.
checks.expected_behavior: Relationships move to surviving record with no dangling references; visiting the merged public URL leads to the surviving record via continuity notice/redirect instead of a bare 404.

checks.setup: Select an existing shared project and verified target account.
checks.expected_behavior: New maintainer receives edit control without creating a new project or erasing contributor history; audit event recorded.

checks.method_or_action: Inspect public API payloads and attempt unauthorized staff/maintainer requests
checks.expected_behavior: Private collaborations, drafts, and legacy emails are absent server-side; unauthorized requests return 401/403; untrusted input cannot execute script or grant permissions.

checks.method_or_action: Navigate core employer, student, and staff workflows via keyboard and at 390 CSS px viewport
checks.setup: Test directory, profile, shared project, partner, inquiry, and staff queue at 390px.
checks.expected_behavior: Visible focus outlines, meaningful labels, no horizontal-only controls.

checks.method_or_action: Load directory over scale_fixture.json (220 students, 110 projects)
checks.expected_behavior: Directory returns bounded page (20 records) with total/page metadata; initial transfer size does not grow linearly with dataset size; no heavy media or playable runtime fetched on directory load.

checks.method_or_action: Test unreachable import URL / broken media / health endpoint and inspect server diagnostic logs
checks.setup: Try importing an unreachable HTTPS URL in /r4-staff.html.
checks.expected_behavior: Public browsing stays usable; human-readable error preserves unsaved draft; server logs timestamped JSON diagnostics with request ID and no secrets.

checks.method_or_action: Inspect shared project with active or unavailable/archived demo_status
checks.expected_behavior: No auto-launch or permission prompt on load; broken/retired demo state shows status note and keeps fallback evidence usable; external demos open isolated from parent session.

checks.method_or_action: Open inquiry from partner/collaboration/student/project and test tampered source_name query parameter
checks.expected_behavior: Inquiry resolves canonical record server-side (ignoring Fake Corp), shows plain-language label without raw UUID/type, and links back to the source page.

checks.method_or_action: Verify R4 partner directory, R4.19 privacy, staff verification/partner queues, and duplicate-pending + rejection-reason fixes
checks.setup: Published partner and demo project remain active; reviewer test access provided in Moodle Online text.
checks.expected_behavior: All R1-R4 core journeys continue working with zero regressions (F.39).
